title: ChatThread
description: A conversation container. Holds user messages and one final assistant message per run.

title.description: Human-friendly title. May be set by user or generated by system.

visibility.description: Who can see this thread in the org.

tags.description: Optional labels for filtering/grouping in UI.

pinned.description: Whether the thread is pinned for quick access.

archivedAt.description: If set, the thread is archived since this time.

lastMessageAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent message in this thread (for sorting).

latestRunId.description: Most recent run for this thread (may still be running).

latestRunStatus.description: Status of the latest run when known.
